paper_title: Solar neutrino limit on axions and keV-mass bosons
notes: Stellar/solar energy-loss bound (not a DM haloscope). Main axion-photon limit g_agamma < 7e-10 GeV^-1 for sub-keV axions. The paper also derives boson-electron Yukawa coupling limits (g_eechi) for PS/S/V cases vs mass (Fig.1), but those are not the primary AxionPhoton coupling and use a generic boson notation. The single AxionPhoton value applies for ma below ~0.2 eV; placed at 0.1 eV as representative mass. | Vision: The exclusion plot (Fig. 1) shows g_eeχ (boson-electron Yukawa coupling) vs m_χ in keV, NOT the axion-photon coupling. The hint suggested AxionPhoton, but the actual plotted constraint is on the electron coupling, so AxionElectron is the appropriate category. The lowest boundary corresponds to the V (vector) curve (blue). Three curves shown: PS (~2.8e-11 floor), S (~2.4e-13 floor), V (~1.7e-13 floor). I traced the V curve. Mass axis converted from keV to eV (0.1-100 keV = 100-100000 eV). The axion-photon limit g_aγ<7e-10 GeV^-1 is in the text but not plotted. | Calibration: Spot-check calibration: verify/stage2 ratio=83.3x
